Meta.title: Bind — DeFi protocol insurance on Stellar
Meta.description: Insurance DeFi protocols contract. Protected Deposit for users; claims settled under the hood. Built for Blend-like markets and wallets.
Meta.ogTitle: Bind — DeFi protocol insurance on Stellar
Meta.ogDescription: Retention-window cover for DeFi protocols. Protocols contract Bind; users get Protected Deposit.

Footer.blurb: DeFi security insurance on Stellar. Protocols contract Bind; depositors get a protected retention window and in-window claims.

Home.eyebrow: Bind · Security insurance for DeFi on Stellar
Home.headline: Insurance protocols can contract.
Home.subhead: Bind holds covered deposits in a timed retention window before free exit — and pays claims if a breach hits while funds stay on the Bind rail.
Home.flowTitle: Cover your protocol buys — not an app users download.
Home.flowBody: Bind sits underneath as the insurance counterparty. You keep the product surface; we own policy, retention, and claims.
Home.flow1Body: Buy cover in basis points. Keep your money market and show Protected Deposit under your brand.
Home.flow2Body: Covered deposits sit in a timed window. Unwrap and swap stay blocked while unsettled.
Home.flow3Body: If a breach hits inside the window, Bind pays approved claims. Off-rail drains need Tier 3 capital.
Home.lanesTitle: Pay with time, or with KYC.
Home.lanesBody: Retention is deferred finality — a documented protected hold, not a mystery lock.
Home.standardBody: Default for every depositor. Longer hold without identity.
Home.fastBody: Partner-vetted KYC shortens the window and improves attacker attribution.
Home.ctaBody: Cover schedule in basis points, a written claims policy, and public proof of reserves — integration in days, not a rebuild.

QuickDemo.s1Title: User wraps 100 USDC into Bind cover
QuickDemo.s1Body: Funds enter the Bind rail as covered credit. Your protocol still owns the money-market UX.
QuickDemo.s2Body: In production this is ~12h without KYC (or ~1h with Fast Lane). Here it compresses so you can feel the block.
QuickDemo.s3Title: Still inside the window — what happened?
QuickDemo.s3Body: No breach → wait to settle and unwrap 1:1. Breach on-rail → open a claim while funds cannot free-exit.
QuickDemo.s4SettleBody: Credit settles. User can unwrap to USDC. No claim needed. Peg stays vault ≥ supply.
QuickDemo.s4ClaimBody: Lot freezes. Claims desk reviews. Approved claim remints settled cover to the rightful party. Clawback is ops under the hood — not the product pitch.

Cover.title: What Bind covers
Cover.coveredBody: Unauthorized movement of unsettled Bind credit (theft key / phishing / fat-finger) inside window T, subject to caps and claims policy.
Cover.not1: Partner protocol exploits, oracles, bad debt
Cover.not3: Settled credit, unwrapped USDC, swapped value
Cover.capsMeta: max lot 10,000 · max claim 10,000 · max open claims / account 3 · max unsettled supply 500,000

Integrate.title: Contract Bind for your protocol
Integrate.body: You are the money market. Bind is the insurance counterparty you buy: Protected Deposit for users, claims desk and PoR for you — not a checkout, not another lending pool.
Integrate.card1Body: Your brand, your KYC, your market. Bind is the cover rail underneath.
Integrate.card2Body: Policy window, freeze/claim, clawback indemnity, Exit Pool, caps.
Integrate.card3Body: Wrap → transfer to protocol custody as unsettled. Blend-like deposits with a claim window.
Integrate.sdkBody: safeDeposit / claimSafeDeposit in @keel/sdk (BindClient alias). Does not implement lending — only the cover movement.

Docs.title: Documentation
Docs.intro: Bind is DeFi protocol insurance on Stellar: protocols contract Bind; users get Protected Deposit. Claims settle under the hood — see
Docs.linkCoverBody: What Bind covers, caps, and exclusions.
Docs.linkPolicyBody: Who can claim, SLA targets, approve / reject.
Docs.linkTermsBody: Demo ToS — recovery facility, not a bank.
Docs.linkIntegrateBody: Safe Deposit + API for protocols and wallets.
Docs.assetBody: Deposit USDC → mint covered credit 1:1. Transfers (and Safe Deposits) create an unsettled lot with window T. After T, settle → settled → unwrap to USDC. Only unsettled lots are claimable.
Docs.inv3: Recover burns the frozen unsettled lot and remints settled credit to the claimant
Docs.inv4: Caps: max lot, max unsettled supply, max claim, max open claims / account
Docs.inv5: Issuer / arbiter keys are multisig in production
Docs.clawbackBody: Clawback is the ambulance, not the brand. It only touches Bind cover lots that are unsettled and under an open claim path (sender or ops role). Settled credit is final. Users opt in; Exit Pool lets them leave early for a fee. Partner exploits and liquidations are excluded — see Cover schedule.
Docs.exitBody: Sell unsettled cover for USDC immediately by paying bps. That fee prices clawback risk and is core usage revenue — Bind does not need a governance token to make money.
Docs.safeBody: For Blend-like markets: wrap → transfer into protocol custody as unsettled. The money market stays yours; Bind only covers the movement window. SDK: safeDeposit, claimSafeDeposit, BindClient.

Policy.title: Claims policy
Policy.scopeBody: Only unsettled Bind credit inside window T. Settled credit and free USDC are final under this policy.
Policy.whoBody: The original sender of the lot (lot.from). Partners may open on behalf of users via signed API in the partner phase.
Policy.approve: clawback / burn frozen lot; remint settled credit to claimant.
Policy.notBody: Settled / unwrapped funds, swaps off-rail, partner protocol exploits, oracles, liquidations, bad debt.

Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.body: Bind is an optional recovery / cover facility — not a bank and not licensed insurance unless separately authorized. Full text:
Terms.li1: Cover only on unsettled lots inside window T.
Terms.li2: Clawback is the claims rail, not the product.
Terms.li3: Partner protocol exploits and liquidations are excluded.
Terms.li4: Liability limited to vault/pool under the Cover Schedule.
